name: approve-grant-recommendation
description: Approve a pending grant recommendation. Marks the recommendation as approved and immediately grants the underlying permission to the contact. Use when the principal says yes to a suggested grant ('yes, grant Dana scheduling access', 'approve that recommendation'). recommendation_id must be the UUID from the recommendation. The id is in the recommendation's task (task-list tag grant-recommendation): the part of its grant-rec:<uuid> tag after the colon. Once this succeeds, task-complete that task with the outcome; if it fails, leave the task open.

inputs.recommendation_id: string (UUID of the pending grant recommendation)

outputs.already_resolved: boolean? (true when it was already approved: nothing changed; close its task)
